lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in roughly vertical columns of 3 to 4 nodes on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs to form a regular grid-like pattern across the posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient running horizontally.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a unique high-density distribution of small, low-intensity spots that contrast with the larger, sparser spots on the lateral flank.
